# Sector — Painkiller’s player review

- Original source: [Robin Hood](https://www.sector.sk/uzivatelrecenzia/156/robin-hood.htm)
- Author / publication: Painkiller; Sector.sk.
- Language / date: Slovak; 2005-05-20.
- Access: Substantial indexed review passages and score inspected; direct retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Painkiller awards the game 9.5, emphasizing the relationship between sparing enemies and attracting recruits. The review describes combining character abilities, hiding incapacitated guards, seeking information from beggars, and responding to optional civilian requests. Once the named heroes are available, the author favors leaving ordinary recruits in camp to make supplies.

The limited variety of castle and forest maps is a criticism despite the enthusiastic overall assessment. This is a player’s account of tactics and reception, not an independently verified rules reference; incidental story details and numerical claims should be checked against the game.
